others.route: Entry/Temporary Residence and Work Permit for artists

note: Cyprus: EEA and Swiss nationals live and work freely (the eea list). The Civil Registry and Migration Department grants a third-country national artist an entry, temporary residence and work permit, through an artistic agent, or for a few days' work in hotels, theatres, circuses and other cultural events; no days of work without it are named, so none are modelled. Read from WhatPassport's copy of the Department's page, undated, since the Department's site (migration.gov.cy) didn't answer this client and its old pages are gone; the Department revised its application forms from 2 April 2026.

sources.title: WhatPassport, Cyprus: Employment Visas for Alien Artists
sources.said: The Civil Registry and Migration Department grants Entry/Temporary Residence and Work Permits to alien artists, who will be employed in musical – dancing places providing entertainment. ... Moreover, this Department grants for individuals, companies, hotels etc. Entry/Temporary Residence and Work Permits to artists, who will work in hotel units, in ... circuses and for other cultural events, for a few days only.
